note: Small secluded rustic campground (opened 2017) on Russ Lake Rd ~1 mi off H-58, between Munising and Grand Marais in the Pictured Rocks area, a mile south of Kingston Lake. Each site has a fire ring and picnic table; also three off-grid cabins. Dry camping; generators 10 am-6 pm only; ATVs allowed on the campground road. Private land: no national lakeshore pass needed. --Claude
summary: Operator site (GoDaddy, copyright 2024) confirms 8 large sites (2 pull-throughs), vault toilet + hand-pump drinking water, reservations online via ResNexus plus cash FCFS at a fee station; $25 drive-in / $30 reserved (2024 page); open May-October; self check-in. Phone on the operator's contact page 906-387-1221 (entry has none). Hookups (none) left as derived: the pages call it rustic/off-grid but never state 'no hookups'. Rate date: the only posted rate ($30 reserved, $25 drive-in) is on a page copyrighted 2024 with 2024 season dates; under US$50 and inside the Pictured Rocks gateway (38 km) either way. Google Maps: open, 4.5 stars / 26 reviews.
